summary: The article accurately reports on SEBI's new risk-based inspection framework, including the reduction in routine checks and the focus on high-risk entities, with details aligning with recent news and official SEBI information.

claims.claim: SEBI is overhauling its inspection framework for market intermediaries, moving from routine checks to a risk-based approach.
claims.note: SEBI announced a revamped inspection framework shifting to a risk-based supervisory model.

claims.claim: The market regulator aims to reduce the volume of inspections by two-thirds compared to previous years, enhancing efficiency.
claims.note: SEBI will conduct approximately one-third of the inspections it carried out in the previous fiscal year, effectively reducing them by two-thirds.

claims.claim: Intermediaries with robust internal controls and good compliance records will likely face fewer, less intensive inspections.
claims.note: SEBI will discontinue repetitive comprehensive inspections of compliant entities, particularly qualified stock brokers (QSBs), unless they repeatedly appear on risk parameters.

claims.claim: SEBI has the authority to regulate market intermediaries under the SEBI Act, 1992.
claims.note: The SEBI Act, 1992, provides SEBI with statutory powers to regulate and oversee various aspects of the securities market, including market intermediaries.

claims.claim: Report anything unusual immediately to your intermediary and, if unresolved, to SEBI's SCORES platform (SCORES is SEBI Complaint Redressal System).
claims.note: SCORES (SEBI Complaints Redress System) is an online grievance redressal facilitation platform provided by SEBI for investors to lodge complaints against SEBI regulated entities.

claims.claim: Familiarise yourself with the Investor Charter provided by SEBI, which outlines your basic rights and responsibilities.
claims.note: SEBI has framed an Investor Charter which includes the vision and mission statement, rights and responsibilities of investors, and investor grievance redressal mechanism.

article_title: SEBI Streamlines Checks, Targets High-Risk Players
